title: A 1.x -> 2.0 update on Linux/macOS applies, then reports FAILED: the old applier rewrites the running launcher
description: MPI-595 A5, Fabio 2026-09-27: fix it. The 1.5.0 applier copyFileSync's each bundled launcher over the running one (same inode); sh resumes at its byte offset in the new file and dies (exit 127), so a perfect update reports FAILED. The wrap (d2379a38f) protects 2.0->2.1 onward only. Evidence: MPI-708 validation.md section MPI-595 Gate A, message 78a7f920.
